summary: Iteration 10 — frontend-only smoke of Milli's new visuals + Retirement Scenario Comparison bug-fix. Backend testing skipped per request. All acceptance criteria PASSED once the correct gate-bypass keys were set (localStorage.milli_selected_plan, localStorage.milli_onboarding_complete, sessionStorage.milli_splash_seen, localStorage.milli_token). Seeded via POST /api/demo/seed → Jordan Taylor / elite. Verified: (1) Dashboard subgreeting reads "Here's your money, Jordan.", (2) dashboard-milli-card-section renders with Manage link (dashboard-card-manage) and MilliCardHero that contains ALL required strings: MILLI, JORDAN TAYLOR, 4218 5632 0464 8202, VISA, ELITE and expiry 05/31, (3) dashboard-available-card renders with 12 inner divs (>4 required) and mini MilliCard is placed in the top-right, (4) Retirement projected card contains ChromeBonsai SVG with viewBox '0 0 220 220' — no deprecated radialGradient id='crown' anywhere on the page, (5) Est. Monthly Income = $8,840/mo (dynamic, no 'placeholder' string), (6) Scenario Comparison — all 3 scenario cards are clickable, each opens the modal with the correct scenario title AND a unique monthly figure: Current Plan $8,840 · Increase to 20% $11,167 · Delay 2 Years $6,833, (7) Top 'View details' link also opens the modal (defaults to Current Plan), (8) Vault header = 'Jordan\u2019s Tax Vault™', (9) More header = 'Jordan account' and more-milli-card renders the identical personalised card (JORDAN TAYLOR / 4218 5632 0464 8202 / 05/31 / VISA / ELITE). No page-error console output on any of the four screens; only harmless React Router 'no routes matched' warnings when hitting /app/dashboard (see action items).

issues: Scenario titles 'Increase to 20%' and 'Delay 2 Years' wrap to two lines inside the pill at 430px width — consider a smaller font-size or nowrap so the balance line-height aligns with the Current Plan card

action_items: OPTIONAL: The Dashboard route is /app (not /app/dashboard). Testing agents were briefed with /app/dashboard which produced a 'No routes matched' warning + login redirect. Either (a) add a duplicate <Route path="/app/dashboard" .../> alias or (b) update the review-request test plan to use /app. Non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: MilliCard.jsx card meta uses a deterministic hash from user id/email — good for demo stability. Consider surfacing the last4 on the mini badge so it matches the '\u2022\u2022\u2022\u2022 4587' text shown in the Available-to-Spend 'Milli Checking' link (currently hard-coded 4587 in Dashboard.jsx vs. dynamic 8202 on the hero card — the two mismatch on-screen).
Retirement.jsx now has an unused/deprecated function GlowingTree() that returns null (leftover from the ChromeBonsai swap). Safe to delete to keep the file lean.

The Scenario 'View details' pattern satisfies the spec, but the top link and the per-card click both funnel into the same modal state. This is fine, but consider adding aria-label='View <scenario> details' on each ScenarioCard for a11y (Lighthouse will flag button without discernible text since the labels are visual pills).
Dashboard.jsx line 492: legacy MetallicMCard function is left as a no-op — safe to remove now that MilliCardMini has fully replaced it.

OnboardingGate + WelcomePaywall gate the app on THREE separate keys (sessionStorage.milli_splash_seen, localStorage.milli_selected_plan, localStorage.milli_onboarding_complete). This is fragile for QA and for returning users who clear cookies. Consider consolidating into a single bootstrap flag or reading it from the /api/auth/me response (user.plan/user.onboarded).
test_credentials: POST /api/demo/seed \u2192 token + Jordan Taylor / plan=elite. Store as localStorage.milli_token. To bypass first-launch gates in tests also set: localStorage.milli_selected_plan='elite', localStorage.milli_onboarding_complete='true', sessionStorage.milli_splash_seen='1'.
seed_data_creation: One-shot /api/demo/seed per run — creates Jordan Taylor with elite plan, 40 deposits, 28 trips, etc.
context_for_next_testing_agent: IMPORTANT gate-bypass keys for testing at https://driver-tax-mileage.preview.emergentagent.com: localStorage {milli_token, milli_selected_plan='elite', milli_onboarding_complete='true'} + sessionStorage {milli_splash_seen='1'}. Without milli_selected_plan the WelcomePaywall overlays every route and hides the actual page (which was masking the retirement modal-click failure in the first two attempts). Dashboard is at /app, NOT /app/dashboard. Stable testids verified this run: dashboard-subgreeting, dashboard-available-card, dashboard-milli-card-section, dashboard-milli-card, dashboard-card-manage, retirement-projected-card, retirement-income-card, retirement-scenarios-viewdetails, retirement-scenario-{current|increase|delay}, retirement-scenario-modal, retirement-scenario-modal-close, vault-header, more-header, more-milli-card.
rca of the issue: N/A this iteration — no active bug reproduced. The previous session's Scenario Comparison + View-details fix is verified working end-to-end. Only latent risk: WelcomePaywall silently overlays protected routes for QA sessions that don't set milli_selected_plan, which caused two false-negative test attempts on the retirement modal before the correct gate-bypass keys were applied.
